cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 90% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.08% · WTI +0.01% · Brent +0.03% · NatGas -0.82%. 90% of 68 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.75%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.75%; weakest is Shale & E&P at +0.09%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +5.80%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +5.80%, FLNC +5.10%, TLN +5.06%, VRT +4.88%, SMR +4.14%. Laggards: APA -0.98%, EPD -0.67%, EQT -0.59%, EOG -0.32%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
